pipeline.modality: Carrier-sparing site-specifically conjugated 31-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV) using cell-free protein synthesis platform
pipeline.license_origin: Internally developed (Sutro Biopharma cell-free expression platform license)

indications.indication: Prevention of invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) and pneumococcal pneumonia in adults aged 50 and older (and 18-49 immunobridging)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, active-controlled Phase 3 program (OPUS-1 head-to-head vs PCV21 and PCV20; OPUS-3 immunogenicity); pivotal program initiated December 2025
key_milestones: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for adult IPD

indications.indication: Prevention of IPD in healthy infants
indications.trial_design: Randomized dose-finding Phase 2 in healthy infants

indications.indication: Prevention of IPD in infants — backup / dose-finding readout informing VAX-31
indications.trial_design: Randomized observer-blind Phase 2 dose-finding study in healthy infants (N=803); final positive data Nov 2025
indications.trial_status: Phase 2 completed November 2025; informs VAX-31 infant program (no further independent advancement currently planned)
key_milestones: Final Phase 2 data Nov 2025; program de-prioritized in favor of VAX-31

excluded_preclinical: VAX-A1 (Group A Strep vaccine) — preclinical; Phase 1 initiation targeted 2026
